shortDescription: Create, update or delete virtual device contexts within Nautobot

options.name: custom_fields
options.description: Must exist in Nautobot and in key/value format

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the virtual device context

options.name: device
options.description: The device that the virtual device context is associated with Required if I(state=present) and the virtual device context does not exist yet

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: identifier
options.description: Unique identifier provided by the platform being virtualized

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the virtual device context Required if I(state=present) and the virtual device context does not exist yet

options.name: primary_ip4
options.description: The primary IPv4 address of the virtual device context

options.name: primary_ip6
options.description: The primary IPv6 address of the virtual device context

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: role
options.description: The role of the virtual device context

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: status
options.description: The status of the virtual device context Required if I(state=present) and the virtual device context does not exist yet

options.name: tags
options.description: Any tags that this item may need to be associated with

options.name: tenant
options.description: The tenant that the virtual device context is associated with

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.

options.name: vrfs
options.description: List of VRFs to associate with this virtual device context.
